keyboards.notes: PBT triple-shot keycaps on ANSI boards, double-shot on ISO. Hot-swap pin count not stated.

reviews.verdict: First inductive-switch keyboard, but it does not turn into a must-buy.
Feels smooth like a mechanical board while offering analog features, with some trade-offs.
Very low, consistent latency; inductive switches set actuation as precisely as the best Hall-effect boards, though they sit loosely in the PCB.
